Algeria.description: The provisional government adopted the green-and-white flag with red crescent and star in 1962; its earlier creation date is disputed.
Algeria.status: documented milestone; not a creation date

Denmark.description: Dannebrog appears on Erik of Pomerania's royal seal dated 1398. Earlier depictions are approximately dated; this is not its creation year.
Denmark.status: documented milestone; not a creation date

Japan.description: A red-disc-on-white flag was regulated for merchant vessels in 1870. Its proportions differed from the current standard and the design is older.
Japan.source_name: US Library of Congress legal report, Japan flag
Japan.status: documented milestone; related earlier version, not a creation date

Malta.description: At independence in 1964 the blue panel behind the George Cross was removed. The red-and-white flag has older origins.
Malta.status: documented milestone; current-version change, not a creation date

Nepal.description: The present construction was adopted with the 1962 constitution; the double-pennant design is older.
Nepal.status: documented milestone; current-version adoption, not a creation date

Palestine.description: The Palestine Liberation Organization adopted the flag as the flag of the Palestinian people in 1964; the pattern was in use earlier.
Palestine.status: documented milestone; not a creation date
